summary:
USPS is the United States Postal Service at usps.com. The eagle mark in the tab is the icon tracking bookmarks request.

Checked 12 November 2026 against usps.com. HTML came from https://www.usps.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.usps.com/assets/images/home/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.usps.com/assets/images/home/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 32245 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48, 256×256.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #004488 comes from the most common non-white pixel in ico-256x256-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: ico-256x256-01.png at 256×256 (png, 14135 bytes) from https://www.usps.com/assets/images/home/favicon.ico.
